statement: Let $D$ be an interior point on side $BC$ of acute $\triangle ABC$. The circumcircle of $\triangle ADB$ meets $AC$ again at $E$; circumcircle of $\triangle ADC$ meets $AB$ again at $F$. Lines $AD, BE, CF$ meet the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$ again at $D_1, E_1, F_1$. Let $I, I_1$ be incenters of $\triangle DEF$ and $\triangle D_1E_1F_1$. Prove $E, F, I, I_1$ are concyclic.
Find all natural numbers $n$ for which there is a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ satisfying $\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^n \sigma(i)(-2)^{i-1} = 0$.

For a positive integer $N$, $T(N)$ = number of arrangements of $1,\ldots,N$ into a sequence $a_1,\ldots,a_N$ with $a_i > a_{2i}$ and $a_i > a_{2i+1}$ whenever valid. (a) Find $T(7)$. (b) If $2^K \mid T(2^n-1)$ with $K$ maximal, show $K = 2^n - n - 1$. (c) Find the maximal $K$ with $2^K \mid T(2^n+1)$.
